preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 50,000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 5 * 10**5 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of elements N is between 2 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 10**5 for A in As for i in range(len(A)))
preconditions.description: Each element in array A is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= B[i] <= 10**5 for B in Bs for i in range(len(B)))
preconditions.description: Each element in array B is between 1 and 100,000.
The total number of elements across all test cases does not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.description: The number of lines in the output matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each line in the output is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line) == max_points(A, B) for line, A, B in zip(stdout_lines, As, Bs))
postconditions.description: Each line in the output is the maximum number of points that can be obtained while converting array A into array B.
